1. THIS PART IS BACKED BY A PUBLISHED MESH, NOT BY A PARAMETRIC SOLID, SO IT CARRIES NO
DIMENSIONED DRAWING. Every number a drawing would call out — a hole diameter, a wall, a
radius, a fit — would be a measurement of a DECIMATED TRIANGULATION and not of the part. The
envelope above is exact because a bound on a triangle soup is exact; a diameter through one
is not. A parametric rebuild, graded against this mesh by cad-refcheck, is what restores the
2. PRINT THE NAMED FILE. Its sha256 is on this sheet so the shop can prove the bytes it sliced
are the bytes this sheet describes.
3. NO TOLERANCE IS STATED because none was measured. See the manufacturing document for the
4. Origin: vendor. cad/part.py is a published-mesh loader (meshshelve, from_mesh,
Part.from_mesh); a decimated triangulation carries no dimension a shop can work to
